description:
The 4StoreyBuilding project is open in eQUEST. You are an energy engineer optimizing the HVAC controls. Your goal is to implement a Supply Air Temperature Reset strategy for the Middle Floor by modifying the cooling and heating coil discharge setpoints.

For ALL five Middle Floor (M.*) Packaged Single Zone (PSZ) systems, perform the following updates:
1. Change the Cooling Coil Discharge Temperature (COOL-SET-T) to 60.0°F.
2. Change the Heating Coil Discharge Temperature (HEAT-SET-T) to 90.0°F.

Navigate to the Air-Side HVAC module to locate the systems (M.S21, M.E22, M.N23, M.W24, M.C25). Note that these parameters are found on the SYSTEM level, not the ZONE level. After applying the changes to all 5 systems, run the annual DOE-2.2 simulation and save the project.
